note: Closed registry of workspace locations, session capabilities, CLI commands and remote resources. Resolve the longest registered prefix with a slash boundary. Alias declarations do not grant permissions. Root bindings come from the active invocation; missing bindings fail explicitly.

workspaces.en: Bound local workspace, work-record directories and skill runtime files. All local resource aliases share this namespace.

tools.en: Capabilities invoked through the active agent session, including file access, web search, image generation, visualization, browser control and artifact presentation.

cli.en: Named executables or shipped script entry points invoked as commands in the selected shell.

remote.en: Internet. Registries, git remotes, image registries, CI runs, object storage. Read through a network; bound by version, digest, or observed head.
